execution.command: Check the Supabase multi_county_auctions table for today's scrape results. Verify: 1) All 46 FL counties have new rows, 2) No county has zero records for today, 3) Fix any 'miami-dade' (hyphen) rows to 'miami_dade' (underscore), 4) Report total new rows inserted today, 5) Flag any counties with judgment_amount NULL rate above 5%. Write results to ~/.claude/logs/scrape-verify.log and if any county failed, create a GitHub issue in breverdbidder/biddeed-ai with label 'scrape-failure'.

Generate a morning auction intelligence brief for Ariel. Query multi_county_auctions for: 1) All active/upcoming auctions in Brevard County, 2) Any new auctions posted in last 24 hours across all 46 counties, 3) Run max bid formula (ARV*70% - Repairs - $10K - MIN($25K,15%*ARV)) on Brevard properties with judgment under $300K, 4) Categorize as BID (ratio>=75%), REVIEW (60-74%), SKIP (<60%), 5) Count totals by county for active auctions. Save report as markdown to ~/daily-briefs/YYYY-MM-DD-auction-brief.md. Keep it concise - Ariel has 20 minutes max.

Run a health check on Supabase instance mocerqjnksmhcjzxrewo.supabase.co. Check: 1) Total rows in multi_county_auctions (should be growing ~200-500/week), 2) Table sizes for all bd_* and zw_* tables, 3) RLS policies are active on all user-facing tables, 4) Edge Functions are responding (hit /api/v1/auctions?county=brevard&limit=1), 5) Any failed Edge Function invocations in last 7 days, 6) Supabase storage usage vs free tier limits. Report findings and flag anything approaching limits.

Load TODO.md from the repo. Find the first unchecked task. Execute it fully: write code, run tests, verify. Mark it [x] in TODO.md. Commit with descriptive message. Push to feature branch. If blocked after 3 attempts, log the blocker and move to next task. Continue until 3 tasks completed or 2 hours elapsed. Push all changes.

It is Friday afternoon. Check for any running Claude Code sessions or pending deployments. 1) List all active scheduled tasks, 2) Verify no deployments are mid-flight, 3) Push any uncommitted work to feature branches, 4) Generate a weekend status summary: what was completed this week, what is pending for Sunday night. Save to ~/weekly-status/YYYY-MM-DD-pre-shabbat.md. Disable overnight-dev-session task for tonight and Saturday.

Verify the BidDeed→ZoneWise data bridge is working. 1) Call Edge Function /api/v1/auctions/geojson?county=brevard and confirm valid GeoJSON response, 2) Check that auction count matches multi_county_auctions active count for Brevard, 3) Verify Clerk JWT auth is working on all 4 Edge Function endpoints, 4) Check ZoneWise.ai/api/health is responding. Log results. If any endpoint fails, create GitHub issue in breverdbidder/zonewise-web.
